Galax-Shh is not an app to determine whether photography is permitted, but a tool to help adjust shutter sounds. It aims for responsible usage considerate of both photographers and bystanders.
Sports requiring silence (e.g. golf galleries), sensitive wildlife or pets, sleeping babies, and quiet venues where photography is permitted.
2. [What We Value] The Role of Shutter Sounds
Shutter sounds inform surroundings and deter unauthorized photography. This app respects that role while supporting quiet etiquette where photography is permitted.
3. [Terms of Use] Prohibition of Unlawful Acts

Use for voyeurism or illegal activities is strictly prohibited. Never use in private spaces (restrooms, changing rooms). Absence of sound does not equal permission to photograph. Comply with laws and rules.
Q. Shutter sound returned after OS update
System or security updates may reset shutter sound settings to default. Tap \'Apply Mute\' in the app again. Enabling \'Auto-Mute on Boot\' is recommended.
Q. Camera still makes sound after changing setting

1. While the camera app is in the foreground, changes do not take effect immediately. Leave the camera app (e.g. return to Home) to apply settings. Using the Quick Settings tile automatically navigates to Home via Accessibility.\n2. On Galaxy devices, shutter sound mute links to system volume. The device must be in Vibrate/Silent mode or System Volume at 0 (the app automatically sets System Volume to 0 when muting and restores it when unmuting).\n3. Future OS updates may change this behavior.
Q. Purpose and safety of Accessibility Service (Home Button)

It automatically returns to the Home screen when tapping tiles while the camera is open to apply mute settings instantly. It has zero screen text reading permission, consuming zero battery and keeping privacy 100% secure.
Q. Failed to change settings or error displayed
On Android 6.0+, \'Modify system settings\' permission is required. Open Settings via the warning card and enable the permission.
Q. What should I do before uninstalling? (Does it restore automatically?)

Due to Android OS security restrictions, no app can detect its own uninstallation or execute code during removal. Therefore, please make sure to restore the shutter sound to default inside this app before uninstalling.\nIf you have already uninstalled without restoring, you can reinstall the app and unmute, or run the ADB command (adb shell settings put system csc_pref_camera_forced_shuttersound_key 1) to restore it at any time.

[Important] Due to Android OS security architecture, apps cannot automatically restore settings upon uninstallation. Before uninstalling Galax-Shh, please tap the button below to restore the camera shutter sound to its default state.
* If uninstalled without restoring, you can reinstall the app and turn off mute, or run the ADB command to restore defaults.
